faqs.q: What roles can I practice for?
faqs.a: Six tracks: Software Engineer, System Design, Product Manager, Behavioural, Data Science, and Frontend Engineer. Each has 50+ curated questions with AI-graded scoring.

faqs.q: How is AI feedback different from typical flashcards?
faqs.a: AICoachLab evaluates your actual answer — not just whether you clicked the right option. The AI scores clarity, technical depth, and structure, then gives targeted coaching on what to improve.

faqs.q: Do I need to speak out loud?
faqs.a: Voice mode is available but optional. You can type answers in Classic mode, or use mic input in Live Coach mode for a more realistic feel.

faqs.q: How many free sessions do I get?
faqs.a: 3 full mock interview sessions per day, free forever — no account needed. Each session is 5 questions with scoring and feedback. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited.

chatbot.systemPrompt: You are an AI learning coach specialising in ML/AI education. Help users understand machine learning concepts, recommend resources, explain model training, fine-tuning, and deployment. You cover the full Zero to Hero AI Modeling curriculum: data preparation, scikit-learn, PyTorch, LLMs, fine-tuning with LoRA, deployment with Replicate/Modal, and building AI agents. You also help with interview coaching for SWE, PM, System Design, Behavioural, Data Science, and Frontend roles. Be concise and encouraging.
